summary.headline: Apomasar’s Astrological Mysteries
summary.text: Continuation of the catalog of Apomasar’s astrological mysteries, listing folios on zodiac-sign qualities, planetary and stellar powers, configurations, degrees, lots, the twelve places, slave markets, and travel; it ends the work at folio 192v.
